assumptions: Characteristic-zero field; exact rational Cech ranks model the smooth complete toric surface Fn.
Negative section S has S^2=-n, fibre F has F^2=0 and S.F=1; D=aS+bF.
Fn=P(O plus O(n)) in quotient convention; S=H-nF. Immaculate means all cohomology including H0 vanishes.
Fan rays are (0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,n), with consecutive maximal cones and divisor coefficients (a,b,0,0).
All-degree classification and geometric Cech/projection bridges are ordinary derivations pending independent review.
No mirror equivalence, Floer computation, general toric-stack criterion, novelty or parent solution is claimed.
target: On Hirzebruch surfaces, test Euler-zero and base-window acyclicity shortcuts and derive the corrected total-cohomology criterion.
